title: Kannu Lal v. State of U.P. & Ors.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashok Bhushan, J.; Virendra Singh, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; petitioner relegated to Supply Code statutory bill remedy.
headnote: Where the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 affords a statutory remedy to challenge an electricity bill, the High Court will not quash the bill in writ jurisdiction or mandamus decision of a representation not referable to any statutory provision.
facts: Kannu Lal petitioned the Allahabad High Court to quash an electricity bill/notice dated 19 February 2008 issued by the State electricity authorities. He alleged the bill was incorrect and raised on a load never sanctioned to him. Counsel also sought a direction that his representation be decided. The Division Bench heard the petitioner and disposed of the writ the same day.

holding_units.holding: A consumer disputing an electricity bill must avail the statutory remedy under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ court will neither quash the bill nor direct decision of a representation that is not referable to any statutory provision.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the 19 February 2008 bill and whether the billed load was sanctioned
not_decided.note: Merits left to the statutory Supply Code remedy.
